name: Steamed sticky rice at the camp
summary: Xôi đồ is in the summit-camp supper on VietNamNet, with grilled chicken, corn wine, and banana wine. It is not the xôi tím on the Bản Đôn list. The price is Check on arrival.
howToEat: With that camp supper, after the summit arrival printed at about 15:30. A recipe was not printed.
